newsitem.title: BULGARIA: IMF disburses $137 mln loan instalment to Bulgaria.
newsitem.headline: IMF disburses $137 mln loan instalment to Bulgaria.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) on Tuesday disbursed a $137 million loan instalment to Bulgaria under a $510 million standby approved in April, the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said.
"On July 29 the money of the second tranche under the 5th standby agreement between Bulgaria and the IMF was transferred into the BNB accounts," BNB said.
The sum of $137 million was the equivalent of 100 million Special Drawing Rights, it said.
The IMF approved the release of the tranche last week following the first review of the 14-month standby.

Bulgaria expects to receive the next IMF tranche of $84.5 million by mid-August without another review of the country's structural reform performance by the IMF board of directors, BNB governor Svetoslav Gavriiski said on Monday.

The $31.7 million first tranche of the standby was disbursed in mid-April along with $147 million under the cereal element of the Compensatory and Contingency Financing Facility to fund grain import costs. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
